_note: ore: what a stroke of mining takes, by ore: `time` seconds at speed 1 for one unit with a tool of tier `grade` or better; with a tool of a lower tier it is slower: every tier short multiplies the speed by `underTool`, so a low tool still works but takes much longer, and a better tool is quicker on the soft ores too (tool speed, tools.ts). How long things take, in one place. gather: real seconds (at 1x speed) to collect ONE unit for an average villager with a good tool (speed factor 1.0); farm is the same for one unit from a field of the first level (a higher level divides it by its craftSpeed). A day is 20 minutes, 12 of them daylight; walking, carrying and the weather come on top. bare: how well bare hands do compared with a good tool (1 = as good). Building, crafting, research and repair are measured in days of labour instead (see buildings.ts, tools.ts, research.json) because they should take about the same fraction of a day however long a day lasts. huntPerDay: food-equivalent a hunter of factor 1 brings home in a day (an estimate for the card of the Chòi thợ săn); gatherDuty: share of working time a gatherer spends gathering rather than walking and carrying (estimate for the cards of the houses). Weather and season slow outdoor work: see weather.json and seasons.json (key "work").
